[![Archived from CRAN](https://img.shields.io/badge/CRAN-archived-lightgrey.svg)](https://cran.r-project.org/package=zipangu) [![Development version on r-universe](https://img.shields.io/badge/dynamic/json?url=https%3A%2F%2Furibo.r-universe.dev%2Fapi%2Fpackages%2Fzipangu&query=%24.Version&label=r-universe)](https://uribo.r-universe.dev/zipangu)

Utility functions and data for Japan-specific formats: parsing addresses and postal codes, Japanese imperial years and public holidays, and kana and kanji-numeral conversion. Archived from CRAN in 2025; the source remains on [GitHub](https://github.com/uribo/zipangu); documentation at [uribo.github.io/zipangu](https://uribo.github.io/zipangu/).
